photos.description: Class II, Big Bend Lodge put-in to Dora Creek on 3/7/14.  Flows should be > 600 cfs at Leggett.  Have run this section up to 12,000 cfs, taking out before the Benbow Dam.  Beautiful scenic run through the redwoods.
